_readme: Skills are earned from lesson 'skills' points; 'german' comes from German XP, 'business' is your degree baseline. Targets = points for 'interview-ready'. Salaries are indicative annual gross CHF – verify.

salaryVerify.note: Salary ranges are indicative for Swiss hospitals and consultancies and vary by region, seniority and employer. Check current data before negotiating.

roles.title: SAP IS-H Application Manager / Consultant
tasks: Operate and support IS-H for patient management and accounting
Analyse incidents, customize, test and transport changes
Implement tariff changes (TARDOC, SwissDRG versions) in the system
Support migration projects (data mapping, parallel run)
certs: SAP Learning Hub (S/4HANA and IS-H basics)
roles.asset: Your business degree helps you understand why patient accounting matters: you can talk revenue, cost and process with finance, not only system settings.

roles.title: Epic Application Analyst (Prelude / Cadence / Resolute)
tasks: Build and maintain Epic modules for registration, scheduling or billing
Work queues, reports and continuous improvement
certs: Epic certification (only via employer sponsorship, e.g. Prelude, Cadence, Resolute HB/PB)
roles.asset: Epic hires analysts from the business side. Your degree plus Swiss process knowledge is exactly what hospitals need to configure Epic for Swiss tariffs and insurers.

roles.title: Business Analyst / Product Owner hospital IT
tasks: Elicit and document requirements with clinics, finance and IT
Own and refine the backlog, run sprint reviews
certs: Scrum.org PSPO I or Scrum Alliance CSPO
roles.asset: BA and PO roles are business roles first. Your Master's gives you structured thinking, business cases and the language of management.

roles.title: Process Manager Order-to-Cash (healthcare)
tasks: Own the revenue cycle from referral to payment
Define and track KPIs (rejection rate ≤ 3 %, days sales outstanding)
Drive root-cause fixes across admission, coding and billing
Steer automation and data quality initiatives
roles.asset: This is the most business-heavy role: finance, KPIs, process ownership. Your degree is a direct qualification here.
